coordinate_system: Original unrotated image, x right and y down; pixel centers at (column+0.5,row+0.5). Exterior rings clockwise on the image, holes counterclockwise; implicit closure.
method: Image-only luminance tracing from the decoded WebP: local substrate and ink levels, subpixel blur-compensated half-contrast isophotes, marching squares, topology-preserving polygon simplification (0.20–0.30 px), rounded image coordinates. The CW crop was used to identify and group marks; it is pixel-identical to the corresponding primary samples. No fonts, generated pictograms, panel geometry, or QR tile.
